# LinuxDojo

> Free, hands-on Linux course in French and English. 12 practical chapters take learners from their first terminal commands to Linux system administration: processes, users and groups, file permissions, packages, systemd services, networking, firewall and cron. Every chapter ends with exercises or CTF-style challenges. No signup, nothing to install.

Key facts:

- Website: {{ '/' | absolute_url }} (French: {{ '/fr/' | absolute_url }}, English: {{ '/eng/' | absolute_url }}).
- Audience: complete beginners, and future SysAdmins, DevOps engineers and pentesters. Most learners are French speakers (France and French-speaking Africa).
- Method: practice first. Chapter 0 opens with a CTF: start a Docker container and find a hidden flag. Learners are asked not to use AI while doing the exercises.
- Exercises: downloadable challenge scripts, cmdchallenge.com, SadServers scenarios, and a Docker-based CTF.
- Practice environment: any Linux VM, or a free Ubuntu VM in the browser (Killercoda playground, Google Cloud Shell).
- Learning path framed as dojo belts: white (chapters 0-2), yellow (3-5), green (6-7), blue (8-9), black (10, then redo the chapter 0 CTF with no AI and no hints).
- Each chapter exists in French (/fr/) and English (/eng/) with the same file name.
- Free and open source: https://github.com/N0vachr0n0/Hands-on-Linux-course. Author: {{ site.author }}.
